summary.text: Corey Luebbering is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican P. Jeremy Mosley.
He manages research projects at A.T. Still University in Kirksville and says he is running on rural health care, education and fair taxation.

paragraphs.text: Corey Luebbering was born in Columbia, Missouri, graduated from Blair Oaks High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Truman State University in 2016 and a graduate degree from A.T. Still University in 2022.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Luebbering said he is originally from St. Thomas, Missouri, came to Kirksville for his undergraduate degree in 2007, and works in research project management at A.T. Still University, where he earned a Master of Public Health.
He said he has held a range of jobs, including work on a relative's dairy farm, in fast food, apartment maintenance and hospital admissions.
Luebbering advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

In the survey, he said he would represent every voter in Adair, Putnam, Sullivan and Mercer counties and criticized Missouri's elimination of individual capital gains taxes, saying it reduced funding for rural hospitals in the district.
He listed access to and sustaining rural health care, education, support for teachers and school staff, fair pay and making sure everyone pays their fair share in taxes as his policy interests.
